implementation_summary: This change implements 'Fix provide_automatic_options override' for the flask project. Fix a bug where setting provide_automatic_options=True on a view function or class had no effect when the config-level PROVIDE_AUTOMATIC_OPTIONS was False. Refactor the logic in add_url_rule so the explicit attribute/argument can both enable and disable automatic OPTIONS handling, overriding the global config. The implementation modifies 7 existing files (CHANGES.rst, docs/config.rst, src/flask/sansio/app.py, tests/test_basic.py, tests/test_blueprints.py) and creates 0 new files. Allow view-level provide_automatic_options to override the global config setting in both directions (enable and disable) Refactor add_url_rule to correctly handle the precedence of view-level vs config-level OPTIONS handling Maintain backward compatibility for views that do not set provide_automatic_options
